title: broker
responsibility: Calls the trusted deployment broker for filtered provider inventory, scoped approvals, a single mutation, and reconciliation of submitted operations.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.constructor.registry
inputs.description: Trusted deploy registry, including approved targets, executable paths and signer public keys.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.constructor.config
inputs.description: Reviewed project or target settings for this operation.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.inspect.project
inputs.description: Project name registered on the trusted deploy host.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.inspect.environment
inputs.description: The single environment addressed by the operation.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.inspect.manifest
inputs.description: Digest binding the reviewed project configuration and scripts.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.authorize.plan
inputs.description: Exact deployment attempt including target, release, predecessor and rollback information.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.apply.plan
inputs.description: Exact deployment attempt including target, release, predecessor and rollback information.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.apply.proof
inputs.description: Signed approval or sign-off envelope to verify.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.apply.artifact
inputs.description: Path of the previously verified build artifact, or null for a rollback.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.reconcile.plan
inputs.description: Exact deployment attempt including target, release, predecessor and rollback information.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.note.item
inputs.description: Tracker item that receives the evidence reference.

inputs.name: DeployBroker.note.message
inputs.description: Redacted human-readable evidence reference to append.

outputs.name: DeployBroker.inspect
outputs.description: A current, filtered observation of the named provider target and its release.

outputs.name: DeployBroker.authorize
outputs.description: The signed single-use approval scoped to this plan.

outputs.name: DeployBroker.apply
outputs.description: Identity and provider read-back of the submitted operation.

outputs.name: DeployBroker.reconcile
outputs.description: The authoritative status or original receipt for an already-submitted operation.

outputs.name: DeployBroker.note
outputs.description: No output. Success confirms Tracker accepted the evidence reference.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The operation could not verify its input, target identity, or expected result.
